ambiguities.explanation: The term 'dial tone' is polysemous in telephony contexts; it can refer to the standard audible signal indicating line readiness, or it can refer to the specific frequency components (350 Hz and 440 Hz) defined in the constraints, or it could imply the generation of a specific pattern of tones rather than a continuous signal.
possible_interpretations: Generate the standard audible signal indicating the telephone line is ready for use.
Generate the specific frequency components (350 Hz and 440 Hz) as defined in the business rules.
Generate a specific pattern or sequence of tones rather than a continuous signal.
context_evidence: System follows North American telephony standard using simultaneous 350 Hz and 440 Hz dial tone.
